title: 第11章 采花蜂黄飞第12章 来袭
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
黄飞此人，不仅武功高强，而且心思狡猾，极其擅长隐匿。
更重要的是，他对于自己的目标总是有着充足的耐心和筹划。
有时候，为了达成一个目标，他甚至愿意筹划数月之久，只为找到最佳的下手机会。
不过，在此期间，黄飞那种狡猾之徒也绝不会轻易收敛他的恶行，更不会停止作案。
他像一只潜伏在暗处的毒蛇，时刻寻找着下手的机会。
正所谓“只有千日做贼的道理，哪有千日防贼的道理”
，无论多么严密的防范，时间久了，也难免会有疏于防范的一天。
想到这一点，吴滔不禁感到一阵忧虑。
黄飞的威胁就像一颗悬在头顶的炸弹，随时都有可能爆炸。
“江辰，你的情报非常重要。”
吴滔看着江辰：“我会把这件事如实上报上去，让上级知道我们的处境和危险。
同时，我们也会加强戒备，确保苏白薇和其她人的安全。”
在得到吴滔的肯定之后，江辰也打算离开这里。
反正，对于江辰而言，苏家小姐苏白薇的死活原本也和他没有什么直接的关系。
之所以把韩飞带到这里来，完全是因为抓到这些罪犯，他也能够获得锦衣卫奖励的功勋值。
功勋值，在锦衣卫中可是个好东西。
它不光是升官的重要考核标准，决定了江辰能否在锦衣卫中步步高升，掌握更大的权力和资源。
而且，功勋值还可以在锦衣卫的藏宝阁中兑换各种珍稀的天材地宝、神兵利器以及内功心法。
这些可都是江辰提升实力、增强自身底蕴的绝佳途径。
想到藏宝阁中那些令人眼馋的宝物，江辰的眼神不禁变得炽热起来。

他深知，只有不断提升自己的实力，才能在锦衣卫中站稳脚跟，而功勋值，就是他实现这一目标的重要工具。
而他此次诛杀妖僧觉明，也不过只能获得五百功勋值，还是看在他揪出了李成器的前提下。
否则一个后天境罪犯，最多奖励二百功勋值。
韩飞的修为是先天境初期，应该能够换个三百点功勋值。
不过若是能将采花蜂黄飞抓捕归案的话，以锦衣卫对他的重视程度，至少也能获得一万点功勋值。
寻常的宗师境武者可享受不了这个待遇，一千点功勋值都撑死了。
返回自己那个位于锦衣卫驻地一隅的小院子，江辰没有片刻耽搁，径直走到书案前，轻轻翻开那本记载着五虎断门刀的古朴刀谱，开始专注地修炼了起来。
content_en:
Huang Fei was not only highly skilled in martial arts, but also cunning and extremely good at hiding.
More importantly, he always has enough patience and planning for his goals.
Sometimes, in order to achieve a goal, he is even willing to plan for months, just to find the best opportunity to make a move.
However, during this period, a cunning person like Huang Fei would never easily curb his evil deeds, let alone stop committing crimes.
He is like a poisonous snake lurking in the dark, always looking for an opportunity to strike.
As the saying goes, "You can only be a thief for a thousand days, but you can't guard against a thief for a thousand days."
, no matter how strict the precautions are, over time, there will inevitably be a day when precautions are not taken.
Thinking of this, Wu Tao couldn't help but feel worried.
Huang Fei's threat is like a bomb hanging above his head, which may explode at any time.
"Jiang Chen, your information is very important."
Wu Tao looked at Jiang Chen: "I will report this matter truthfully and let my superiors know our situation and danger.
At the same time, we will also strengthen our vigilance to ensure the safety of Su Baiwei and others. "
After getting Wu Tao's affirmation, Jiang Chen also planned to leave here.
Anyway, for Jiang Chen, the life and death of Miss Su Baiwei of the Su family had no direct relationship with him.
The reason why Han Fei was brought here was entirely because by catching these criminals, he would also be able to obtain the merit points rewarded by the Jin Yiwei.
Merit points are a good thing among Jin Yiwei.
It is not only an important evaluation criterion for promotion, but also determines whether Jiang Chen can rise higher in the Jinyi Guard and gain greater power and resources.
Moreover, the merit points can also be exchanged for various rare treasures of heaven and earth, magical weapons, and internal skills in Jinyiwei's Treasure Pavilion.
These are all excellent ways for Jiang Chen to improve his strength and enhance his own foundation.
Thinking of the coveted treasures in the Treasure Pavilion, Jiang Chen's eyes couldn't help but become hot.
He knows very well that only by continuously improving his strength can he gain a firm foothold in the Imperial Guard, and merit points are an important tool for him to achieve this goal.
And this time he could only get 500 merit points for killing the demon monk Jueming, and that was based on the fact that he had uncovered Li Chengqi.
Otherwise, a Houtian realm criminal will be rewarded with a maximum of 200 merit points.
Han Fei's cultivation is at the early stage of the Xiantian realm, and he should be able to exchange for 300 merit points.
However, if the flower-picking bee Huang Fei can be captured and brought to justice, given the importance Jin Yiwei attaches to him, he will be able to gain at least 10,000 merit points.
Ordinary Grandmaster level warriors cannot enjoy this kind of treatment, and a thousand points of merit points would be too much for them.
Returning to his small courtyard located in the corner of Jinyiwei's residence, Jiang Chen didn't hesitate for a moment. He walked straight to the desk, gently opened the ancient knife manual that recorded the Five Tigers' Door-Breaking Knife, and began to practice attentively.
